LESSON: WRITING 7.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING: NARRATIVE COMPOSITION

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Writing 7.3.1 Creative Writing: Narrative composition
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 7.3.1 Creative Writing: Narrative composition, part of Strand 7 in Grade 6 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do we develop a good narrative?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work jointly to highlight the elements of a good composition (introduction, body, conclusion)

2. team up to collect ideas on the theme for a narrative composition,

3. write a narrative composition on careers and professions creatively,

4. share their compositions with peers for review based on accuracy, creativity and grammar,

5. team up to participate in a writing contest to practice writing narratives.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work jointly to highlight the elements of a good composition (introduction, body, conclusion)
2. team up to collect ideas on the theme for a narrative composition,
3. write a narrative composition on careers and professions creatively,
4. share their compositions with peers for review based on accuracy, creativity and grammar,
5. team up to participate in a writing contest to practice writing narratives.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 7.3.1 Creative Writing: Narrative composition together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: This is developed as the learner embraces ideas that inspire creativity to compose their

own compositions on the theme.

● Self-efficacy: This is promoted as the learner prioritises tasks effectively when teaming up to collect ideas on the theme

for a narrative composition.

42

Values:
● Unity: This is cultivated as the learner collaborates to share their compositions with peers for review.

● Responsibility: This is developed as the learner takes initiative to participate in a writing contest to practice writing

narratives.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: This is developed as the learner works jointly with peers to accomplish tasks and participate in

writing contests.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of narrative writing to writing strands in English.
